sql: CREATE TABLE audit_sets(id INT PRIMARY KEY,v INT)
SELECT DISTINCT v FROM audit_sets ORDER BY v NULLS FIRST
SELECT v FROM audit_sets WHERE id<3 UNION SELECT v FROM audit_sets WHERE id>2 ORDER BY v NULLS FIRST
SELECT v FROM audit_sets WHERE id<3 INTERSECT SELECT v FROM audit_sets WHERE id>1 ORDER BY v NULLS FIRST
SELECT v FROM audit_sets WHERE id<3 EXCEPT SELECT v FROM audit_sets WHERE id>2 ORDER BY v NULLS FIRST
SELECT id,v,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY v ORDER BY id) AS rn FROM audit_sets ORDER BY id
